summary.text: A coral group is a natural refinement path resource point whose corals hold abundant refinement path Gu materials.

claims.text: Fang Yuan places his attention on a certain coral group deep in the sea. These corals contain abundant refinement path Gu materials; they are a natural refinement path resource point of heaven and earth, with very high value, and have not been discovered by anyone.

He uses time path killer moves to observe how the coral group formed. Thousands of years earlier there was nothing there; then a sunken fish died there. The refinement path and rule path dao marks of the sunken fish spread out and influenced the surroundings. After a few hundred years the corpse decomposed entirely and the environment stabilized. Fish, shrimps, larger beasts, seeds, and corals arrived over time, and after thousands of years of development this resource point formed.

His focus is on the refinement path dao marks of the coral group, which for thousands of years increased and decreased unstably until the group reached its present size. Replicating that dao mark development could create such a refinement path resource point in the sovereign immortal aperture given enough time.

The coral group Fang Yuan saw earlier is a refinement path resource point. Its source is an immemorial sunken fish that died thousands of years ago; its refinement path dao marks scattered in the surroundings, and a portion was left behind in that location. Refinement path dao marks and resources influence each other: where dao marks are dense, related resources are more abundant and higher quality. He can strengthen refinement path resource points like the coral group by using refinement path dao marks he has refined.
